relations.subject: Pierre Antoine Louis Havet
relations.evidence: He was the son of Ernest Havet.

relations.subject: Pierre Antoine Louis Havet
relations.role: professor and chairman of the department of Latin philology
relations.evidence: He was professor at Collège de France, where between 1885 and 1925 he was chairman of the department of Latin philology.

relations.subject: Pierre Antoine Louis Havet
relations.evidence: Beginning in 1893, he was a member of the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres.

relations.subject: Pierre Antoine Louis Havet
relations.evidence: In 1917, he became the first vice-president of the Association Guillaume Budé.
